requirements.text: we can mark the conversation as handled
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction WHERE interaction_id = 80 AND status = 'handled'
assumptions: Derek from Globex is Derek Blake, user 622 (derek.blake7@globex.com), contact 3 at account 4 (Globex)
'alerted earlier' picks interaction 80, Derek's only interaction on the alert channel; it is open on the seed
the handled branch applies, not 'keep the interaction open': knowledge 7 (published, external) documents keeping a snapshot before rollback with Btrfs/Snapper

requirements.text: notify them about the knowledge that can help them
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE notification_id = 734 AND case_id = 80 AND email = 'derek.blake7@globex.com' AND knowledge_id = 7 AND type = 'solution_proposal'
assumptions: case 80 is the case interaction 80 belongs to; notification.case_id is NOT NULL and no new case is to be logged
recipient is Derek Blake's email; 'them' is Derek of Globex
knowledge 7 is the only article naming Btrfs/Snapper with rollback, and its external visibility lets a customer be told of it
type solution_proposal kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy

requirements.text: the knowledge that can help them
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_kb_id = 528 AND case_id = 80 AND knowledge_id = 7 AND used_as = 'suggested'
assumptions: implied by the request, not stated: the article offered to Derek is linked to the case of the interaction it was offered in
used_as suggested: the policy links knowledge found through search as suggested, and the request only says it can help, not that it resolved anything

requirements.text: so no case is required as of now
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id > 1232
assumptions: the request rules out a new case once knowledge is found; 1232 is the highest case id on the seed
no tool in the task's list creates cases

disagreement: selector: A contact_id = 3 staying at 5, B case_id > 1232 staying at 0; chose case_id > 1232 because it fails on any new case whichever contact it names, which is exactly what the request rules out, while a count of Derek's cases misses a case logged under another Globex contact

requirements.text: I got alerted earlier by Derek from Globex
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction WHERE interaction_id IN (81, 94) AND status = 'open'
assumptions: interaction 81 is Derek Blake's other open interaction, on the community channel rather than an alert
interaction 94 is Globex's other open alert, raised by contact 4 rather than Derek

disagreement: selector and expected: A interaction 81 alone (1), B interactions 81 and 94 (2); chose both because 94 is the open Globex alert a loose reading of 'alerted by ... Globex' would sweep in, and the set contains 81

requirements.text: anything documented on the snapshot rollback Btrfs/snappers
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE email = 'derek.blake7@globex.com' AND knowledge_id IN (38, 66, 127)
assumptions: knowledge 38, 66 and 127 mention a Snapper snapshot before change but neither Btrfs nor rollback, and all three are internal, which the policy restricts to agents

notes:
The request is conditional on knowledge existing. Knowledge 7 (SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 15, published, external) documents keeping a snapshot before rollback with Btrfs/Snapper, so the handled branch applies and the keep-open branch is not tested.
The benchmark's notification query compares case_id and knowledge_id with quoted strings; SQLite's integer affinity makes these match the integers 80 and 7, so the requirement states them as integers.
The case-knowledge link is the least certain requirement: the request never asks for a link, and case 80 concerns a different product (Microsoft SQL Server 2019 Patchset 27) from the article (SLES 15); it is kept because the link tool is offered and the article is offered to Derek through that case, which is otherwise left unchanged.
The acting user, Scott Mitchell (user 41), has role admin on the seed. The notification's status is set when it is sent and is not tested. Linking further Snapper articles to case 80 is not restricted, since the policy lets agents see internal articles.
disagreement: value: the stay that no case is logged: one pass counts Derek's cases (contact 3, 5 on the seed), the other any case above the seed's highest id (0); chose the latter, as recorded on the requirement.
disagreement: value: the boundary stay on Derek's interactions: one pass interaction 81 alone, the other 81 and 94; chose both, as recorded on the requirement.
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay that Derek is not notified of the internal Snapper articles 38, 66 and 127: one pass wrote it, the other did not; kept because the policy makes internal articles visible to agents only, and these three are the near matches a loose reading of 'snapshot rollback Btrfs/snappers' would sweep in.
disagreement: form: the knowledge-link requirement quotes 'notify them about the knowledge that can help them' in one pass and 'the knowledge that can help them' in the other, with identical cells; kept the shorter quote because the link is implied by the knowledge, not by the notifying.
